inputs: Scientific design objective, explicit constraints, candidate representation, scoring/evaluation model or executable evaluator, available design/search tools and prior candidate results
environment_state: Finite or open-ended scientific design space with potentially expensive evaluation and interacting constraints
allowed_information: Task-visible scientific specification, JIT domain knowledge, Brain-owned/open tools, prior evaluated candidates; no hidden target solution
required_output_or_action: Generate or propose novel candidate designs, choose search or optimization actions, rank/select candidates using the declared objective and constraints, and return a design set or next experiment whose provenance and constraint satisfaction are explicit
success_condition: Fresh held-out design tasks produce valid novel candidates meeting hard constraints and achieve independently verified objective quality at or above the bound target criterion, with no omitted load-bearing constraint
failure_condition: Only analyzes existing evidence without producing candidate designs; generates invalid or duplicate candidates; optimizes a proxy while violating a hard constraint; ranks candidates inconsistently with the declared objective; or depends on an opaque donor capability at execution time
terminal_consequence: Shared transform for scientific and engineering tasks whose useful output is a new design rather than only analysis, retrieval, or synthesis
verification_route: Predeclare design space, hard constraints, objective/evaluator and tool policy; compare on fresh held-out design tasks; use independent evaluator; ablate donor/model-specific execution before ownership credit
dependency_boundary: Deterministic constraint checking and explicit objective evaluation may be owned tooling; proposal generation and adaptive search policy remain the capability residual unless exhaustively solved
